title: Understanding Model Complexity
text: Model complexity in linear regression can be influenced by the number of features and the regularization parameter, lambda. Consider how lambda affects the penalty on the coefficients.

hintAnswer: The coefficients are shrunk towards zero, reducing complexity.

title: Regularization and Complexity
text: Increasing lambda in regularization techniques like Ridge regression adds more penalty to the size of the coefficients, which can help in reducing overfitting by simplifying the model.
